data.one_liner: A community material design icon set for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive set of community material design icons through an easy-to-use icon class. It integrates with standard Flutter Icon widgets using standard imports.
use_when: You need community material design icons not present in the default Flutter material set
You want a straightforward Icon data source without complex configuration
avoid_when: You only need standard built-in Material icons
strengths: Easy to integrate into existing Flutter projects
Expands the available icon library significantly using materialdesignicons.com
weaknesses: Increases app binary size by including a large font/icon set

alternatives.name: cupertino_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your app targets iOS-centric designs and needs Apple's Cupertino icon set instead of Material.
